data.name: Indar
data.long_meaning: Indar is the name of the God of Rains, Wind and Thunder in Hindu Mythology. He is also known as the King of Heaven. In the Vedas, Indra is depicted as the god of rain, thunder, and the sky. He is also the god of war and power. Indra is the god of the Indian subcontinent and is one of the most important deities in Hinduism.
